subject.title: Himalaya skill: missing email formatting philosophy and incorrect command syntax

question: Should Himalaya receive a final narrow bundled-documentation correction before removal, or should all remaining guidance move directly to the existing ClawHub skill?
rationale: The syntax defects are concrete, but the active member-authored starter-set refactor changes the permanent package owner and the broader formatting guidance needs an intentional scope.

options.title: Fix Then Externalize
options.body: Land only the verified command corrections in the currently shipped skill, then make the existing ClawHub skill the maintained source for expanded guidance.

options.title: Externalize Immediately
options.body: Resolve the bundled surface through the starter-set removal and require the existing ClawHub skill to absorb all verified corrections before users are directed to it.

options.title: Retain In Core
options.body: Keep Himalaya bundled and assign ongoing core ownership for CLI-version, formatting, provider, and upstream-bug documentation.

recommendation.title: Fix Then Externalize
recommendation.body: Land only the verified command corrections in the currently shipped skill, then make the existing ClawHub skill the maintained source for expanded guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: The active member-authored refactor directly determines whether Himalaya remains bundled or moves to ClawHub.
